subject: English
passage: Australia is home to the Great Barrier Reef, a coral ecosystem containing approximately 2,900 individual reefs that form one of the most biodiverse marine environments on Earth. Marine biologists are concerned that the reef's health is deteriorating in part because of rising ocean temperatures. The scientists say that improved water quality monitoring could help detect temperature changes early and help the reef system recover more effectively.
prompt: According to the text, why are marine biologists concerned about the Great Barrier Reef?

choices.A: Its condition is worsening compared to previous years.
choices.B: It isn't forming new coral reefs anymore.
choices.C: It can't expand into deeper waters because it is limited by monitoring equipment.
choices.D: Its marine environment can't support many more species.

explanation:
Choice A is the best answer because it presents an explanation that is directly stated in the text for why marine biologists are concerned about the Great Barrier Reef. The text states that the reef is one of the most biodiverse marine environments on Earth. According to the text, marine biologists are concerned that the reef's health is deteriorating, partly because of rising ocean temperatures. In other words, the scientists are concerned that its condition is worsening compared to previous years.

Why C is incorrect:

Choice C is incorrect because the text states that monitoring equipment can be used to help the reef system recover, not that the reef itself can't expand because it's limited by monitoring equipment.
